claim: §9 does not forbid frontmatter in log.md (§8 forbids it only for index.md), and the upstream acme_retail example bundle ships a log.md with frontmatter. A v0.2 consumer must not reject it.

divergence.detail: All engines emit OKF006 (error) for log.md frontmatter, so upstream's own acme_retail bundle is reported non-conformant. Resolve by downgrading OKF006 to a warning or by getting the upstream spec to state the rule.
